key_points: Evercore upgraded NTAP on strong FY27 growth outlook, driving shares to 52-week highs
Multiple analyst upgrades and positive coverage reinforcing momentum
Insider sales (CEO, directors) appear routine 10b5-1 plan executions, not signal of concern
Valuation concerns raised (19% overvalued per Yahoo, GF Value) but offset by growth outlook
Sector tailwinds with HPE/ANET also hitting highs suggest broader storage/infrastructure strength
